instructions: Cut the potatoes into 1/2 inch cubes. Slice the onion thinly. Dice the pepper.
Heat the oil in your largest skillet over medium heat. Add the potatoes, onion and pepper and toss to coat in the oil.
Cover and cook for 10 to 13 minutes, stirring now and then. After about 6 minutes, stir in the salt and pepper.
When a potato splits easily against the spatula, take off the lid and turn the heat to medium-high.
Cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring now and then, until the potatoes are browned on most sides.
Squeeze in the juice of half the lime. Grate the zest of the lime over the top and stir.
Taste it. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt or a squeeze of the rest of the lime.
method_notes: Cup of Yum leads: 5.0 from 141 ratings. Its home fries are russet potatoes and sweet onion cooked covered in a skillet, then uncovered to brown, with lime juice and zest. That page has no pepper; the green pepper comes from Garlic and Zest (4.72 from 14), which fries the same way, because the list promises peppers. The source makes 2 servings, so it is doubled here and needs the biggest skillet you have. About 35 minutes in all, so over a 15 minute morning.
